commit_message: Add Bloom GPU readback regression tests
pr_title: Renderer: verify Bloom affects final pixels on current main
pr_body:
## Summary

Rebases the Bloom GPU readback regression coverage from Draft PR #86 onto current main without changing production renderer behavior.

- verifies enabled Bloom changes final tone-mapped pixels
- verifies disabling Bloom restores the baseline
- verifies a localized HDR source spreads Bloom energy outside its source footprint
- returns early only when no GPU adapter is available

This is a test-only replacement for #86. Visual Validation is N/A.

## Validation

Run exact-head affected Windows Validation for `engine-render-runtime` and use only the result for this PR head.
